note: Each `lines` floor is the MEASURED percentage of the whole-corpus run that introduced the gate, rounded down; `measured` records that reading so the next reader can see how far the floor has drifted. `modules` and `populationLines` are floors of their own: measured 2026-10-31, removing components/management-panels.tsx (87.1% covered) RAISED the rendered percentage from 88.17% to 88.31%, so a percentage-only floor stays green while the largest panel disappears. A group whose population shrank is a breach even when its number went up. `state` was lowered once, deliberately: 16 modules / 3181 lines to 15 / 3150 when `management-pipeline-session.ts` (408 lines, zero importers) was deleted as dead code - the population floor did its job by making that deletion visible, and this line records the decision rather than hiding it.
